description: Defines an enum 'MenuItemHighlightColors' containing a nested struct 'Palette' and static methods to determine highlight colors for menu items based on their selection state.

methods.name: primary(_ highlighted: Bool) -> Color
methods.description: Returns a primary highlight color based on whether the menu item is highlighted.

methods.name: secondary(_ highlighted: Bool) -> Color
methods.description: Returns a secondary highlight color with opacity adjustment when highlighted.

methods.name: palette(_ highlighted: Bool) -> Palette
methods.description: Constructs a Palette object with primary and secondary colors based on highlight state.
